hint.levelUp.title: Level up
hint.levelUp.text: Skills fire on their own. Rank a skill up to its last rank to awaken it.
hint.metinWarn.title: Awakening clock
hint.metinWarn.text: Break it before {time} or it awakens: stronger, but pays more.
hint.metinAwaken.title: Awakened Metin
hint.metinAwaken.text: It calls elites and raises corruption, but pays far better. Break it to end it.
hint.corruption.title: Corruption
hint.corruption.text: More enemies, better loot. Breaking Metins lowers it.
hint.chestLocked.title: Chests
hint.chestLocked.text: A chest costs Yeop. Whatever you leave unspent is banked for the blacksmith.
hint.boss.title: Boss
hint.boss.text: Bosses drop gear for your class. Duplicates become Metin shards.
hint.essence.title: Metin Essence
hint.essence.text: Essence cards fill your spirit sockets. The same stone upgrades up to +4; a full socket gets replaced.
hint.reroll.title: Reroll
hint.reroll.text: Draws a fresh set of cards. Rerolls are limited per run: {n} left.
hint.banish.title: Banish
hint.banish.text: Removes a card from your pool for the rest of the run. Banishes are limited: {n} left.
hint.pact.title: Awakening pact
hint.event.title: Run event
hint.event.text: Something big stirs once a run. Read the banner, watch its timer, and decide if the reward is worth the risk.
hint.affix.title: Elite affixes
hint.affix.text: Elites carry affixes: read the sigil on the ground beneath them to know what they do.
hint.setting.hint: A one-line tip the first time something new shows up: corruption, an awakening, a locked chest.
hint.reset.hint: Show every tip again ({n} of {total} seen).
hint.reset.none: You have not seen a tip yet.
hero.reco.tip: Strikes from range and backs itself with blessings and healing: the most forgiving hero while you learn the game.
announce.ev.bargain.active.sub: Stand on it for {channel} s to make a bargain: {time}
